_comment: Registry for hub/app.py: one entry per app, in nav order. module: hub/apps/<module>.py (default: id with - as _); view: hub/web/views/<view>/ (default: id); options: keyword arguments for the module's start() (per-machine overrides are saved from the page into configs/hub/local.json); first: start before the others (services other apps use); preload: mount the view at page load.

apps.name: UMI data collection
apps.description: umi-data-collection on the excavator Pi (hostname bucket): its API is relayed by the hub with the access token; the page is the same view module the Pi serves. URLs and token file: hosts.pi in configs/hub/local.json (see local.example.json).

apps.name: GPIO bridge
apps.description: The ESP32 over Bluetooth LE, held by the hub: manual pin control, pin names, session recordings. Policy rollout, calibration and scripts (ws /api/gpio/ws) all go through it.

apps.name: Inference
apps.description: Run the Lambda-served π0.5 policies on the real excavator: arm, calibrate, checkpoints, E-STOP.

apps.name: Twin replay viewer
apps.description: Recordings of the policy run configs side by side with their MuJoCo twin replay (the config's reconstruct and labels stage outputs: python -m policy reconstruct|labels <config>); episode labelling (verdicts feed source.exclude).
